# Where novelty's gain comes from

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`where-novelty-gain-comes-from` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](where-novelty-gain-comes-from.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> With the rest counted, every rise is given; under the first law a family without repetition gains from the rest or across its boundary; a finite whole the rest gives nothing net returns and is not new at every step; novelty and endless new formation need gain.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. With the rest of the whole counted (Flow.withImbalance), by the definition of the rest as the residual, across a step at which a family's stock rises some relatum taking part gives the family more than it takes from it, a formation taking part or the rest; it is found by checking each one taking part, deciding nothing infinite; a rise over a stretch is given at some step of it. (`Becoming.Flow.NetGiver`, `Becoming.Flow.rise_netGiver`, `Becoming.Flow.netGiver_cases`, `Becoming.Flow.rise_given`, `Becoming.Flow.rise_given_between`, `Becoming.some_mem_tail`)
2. The rest gives the family net exactly where, summed over the family, the levels rose beyond what the formations gave net by more than they fell beyond what the formations took net; where the flow balances on the family, the rest gives it nothing net. (`Becoming.Flow.rest_netGiver_iff`, `Becoming.Flow.BalancesOn.rest_not_netGiver`)
3. Under the first law (Flow.Gainless), a family without repetition that rises across a step is given net by the rest or is open there: some formation taking part exchanges beyond it. (`Becoming.Flow.rise_from_rest_or_open`)
4. Where a list holds every condition without repetition, the whole has no boundary to cross, and under the first law every rise of it is the rest's; with the rest giving it nothing net from T on, it stays within its stock at T, has two equal configurations from every step on, does not carry the count of endless exchanges, and is not new at every step. (`Becoming.Flow.whole_rise_from_rest`, `Becoming.Flow.whole_bounded_of_rest_idle`, `Becoming.Flow.whole_recurs_of_rest_idle`, `Becoming.Flow.whole_not_new_of_rest_idle`)
5. Novelty needs gain: a family whose configurations at the steps T, …, T + N all differ, N the number of configurations within its stock at T, rises at one of those steps; one new at every step rises at arbitrarily late steps; so do first visits without end (configurations not had since T), consecutive or not. (`Becoming.le_of_increasing`, `Becoming.Web.rises_within_of_new`, `Becoming.Web.rises_late_of_new`, `Becoming.Web.NewAt`, `Becoming.Web.exceeds_of_firsts`, `Becoming.Web.rises_late_of_firsts`)
6. A family holding the members of one new at every step is new at every step too; under the first law each such rise comes from the rest or across the family's boundary, for every family without repetition holding it: no finite family closes over endless novelty. (`Becoming.map_eq_at`, `Becoming.map_eq_on`, `Becoming.Web.config_eq_of_sub`, `Becoming.Web.new_of_sub`, `Becoming.Flow.new_from_rest_or_open`, `Becoming.Flow.new_beyond_every`)
7. New formation needs gain: where what a formation requires, and how much, stays fixed and lies within the family (Web.RequiresWithin), whether the family's levels support it depends on the configuration alone, so a step at which it is first supported is a first visit; with formations first supported without end, the family rises at arbitrarily late steps, under the first law from the rest or across the boundary. (`Becoming.Web.RequiresWithin`, `Becoming.Web.supported_of_config`, `Becoming.Web.FirstSupported`, `Becoming.Web.newAt_of_first`, `Becoming.Web.rises_late_of_newly_supported`, `Becoming.Flow.newly_supported_from_rest_or_open`)
8. Witness: in Web.counting, whose level is the step, nothing takes part (Flow.empty, under which nothing comes from nothing); it is new at every step, and the rest gives it one unit at every step, the one way in that a finite whole has. (`Becoming.add_one_sub_self`, `Becoming.Flow.empty`, `Becoming.Flow.empty_gainless`, `Becoming.Flow.counting_given_by_rest`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. What each law needs is written into it: the first law (Flow.Gainless), the family listed without repetition (Distinct), for the whole a list holding every condition, the rest giving nothing net from T on, what a formation requires fixed within the family (Web.RequiresWithin); the giver is found by checking each relatum taking part, deciding only inequalities of natural numbers.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Whether an actual part is open, which relatum the rest is in an actual unfolding, or whether its exchange is without end: these are correspondence, given per application.
- Gain is not openness: a family can be closed and gain from the rest, and openness can carry a net of zero. Witness: `Becoming.Flow.counting_given_by_rest`.
- Whether the bound by the configurations within the stock is reached, by a family realizing that many first visits, is not stated.
- No correspondence to open systems or free energy in thermodynamics is checked.
- Continuous time and real amounts are not stated.
- **Counterexample:** Web.counting with Flow.empty: nothing takes part and the family is closed, yet counting on is new at every step, the rest giving one unit at every step; so the condition that the rest gives nothing net cannot be dropped from the return of a finite whole. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Gain.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A conditional law does not make its antecedent universal; a theorem's premise is not thereby necessary for every achievement.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Ren, 15 October 2026: “What's the best choices to make? please make best of your judgement, and push the frontier of completeness”. The readings of returning-novelty-forgetting-on-levels, that novelty without end is gain without bound which must come from beyond the part, and that a bounded present cannot hold its own history, become theorems here: with the rest counted every rise is given; under the first law gain has two ways in, across the boundary or from the rest; a finite whole has no boundary, and with the rest idle it returns and forgets. Readings (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation of 15 October 2026, DELEGATED-CHOICES D5, D7): “gain from beyond the part” reads as these two ways in; openness and gain are kept apart; 生生不息 reads at the level of the whole, where in a bounded whole with the rest idle it is return, not endless novelty; the rest counts what the listed relata do not, so a finite whole new without end is one whose listing leaves out what gives to it. Becoming.Coupling states the counterpart for moves: moves formed by what a list holds repeat within the list's length.
